overview: Brick-built “chibi minifigure” Jedi in white outfit holding a blue lightsaber, matching the reference pose and proportions (big head, compact torso, short legs). Built as a small display model using mostly white/light gray with tan/blonde accents and a blue translucent blade.

subassemblies.name: Display base (optional)
subassemblies.description: Small dark/neutral plate base to stabilize the stance; simple 6x6-ish footprint with studs to lock in feet.

subassemblies.name: Legs + hips block
subassemblies.description: Two blocky legs in white with subtle tan/gold-ish stripe hints using small plates/tiles; connect to a 2–4 stud wide hip section that supports the torso. Keep legs slightly staggered to mimic the walking/ready stance.
subassemblies.image_location: Lower half of the figure (bottom third)

subassemblies.name: Torso (white tunic + belt)
subassemblies.description: Main chest/waist core in white. Add a brown/red belt band around the waist (use reddish brown/dark red/red plates/tiles) with a small front ‘pouch’ detail. Slight front shaping using plates/tiles to suggest the robe overlap.

subassemblies.name: Arms (2x)
subassemblies.description: Two articulated-looking brick arms in white, built as simple stacked bricks/plates. Position both arms forward and inward to create the two-handed grip pose.
subassemblies.image_location: Left and right sides of the torso, angled toward the center

subassemblies.name: Hands + saber grip cluster
subassemblies.description: Compact cylindrical/stacked light-bluish-gray and trans-clear elements to suggest the metallic hilt. Build a small central ‘grip’ block the arms attach to from both sides so the saber reads as held with two hands.
subassemblies.image_location: Center-right of the figure, in front of the torso

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber blade
subassemblies.description: Straight blue/trans-light-blue blade using trans-clear/blue elements (or trans-clear with blue accents). Ensure it reads as a single line; anchor into the hilt securely.
subassemblies.image_location: Extending upward from the hands to the top-right corner

subassemblies.name: Head (face block)
subassemblies.description: Large, smooth-ish head using white/tan/light-nougat tones; add simple face features (eyes/brows/mouth) with small dark tiles/plates or printed tiles if available. Keep it slightly taller than the torso for the chibi look.

subassemblies.name: Hair (blonde swept style)
subassemblies.description: Layered tan/yellow/light-blonde plates/slopes around the top and sides of the head to mimic the swept, slightly shaggy hair. Overhang a bit at the forehead.
subassemblies.image_location: Top of the head, framing the face

notes: Color matching: prioritize White for outfit, Light Bluish Gray/Dark Bluish Gray for hilt, TransClear + blue parts for the blade, Tan/Yellow for hair, ReddishBrown/DarkRed/Red for belt details.
Keep the model buildable with simple stacked geometry; the “pose” is mainly achieved by offsetting arms and legs using plates/tiles rather than complex joints.
If the blade must be more vibrant, mix TransClear segments with DarkAzure/MediumAzure plates near the base as a glow accent.
Aim for a 4–6 stud wide body; head 6–8 studs wide for the minifig-like proportions.
